column1: # ZAP rules config — controls which alert IDs cause the scan to fail.
#   FAIL  → job exits non-zero (blocks merge if on a required check)
#   WARN  → printed but job still passes
# We FAIL on high-severity injection / auth issues; WARN on everything
# else so the report is still generated without breaking CI on a first run.

column3: # Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — locale-switcher forms only; session cookie has SameSite=Lax which is the accepted CSRF mitigation here
